name: CacheWarp
impact: Malicious hypervisor drops cached writes in an SEV-SNP guest, reverting memory to stale values and corrupting the guest's integrity (loss of SEV-ES/SEV-SNP memory integrity)
mitigation: AMD microcode/firmware update (AMD-SB-3005); Zen 4 and later unaffected by design
boundary_statement: CacheWarp (CVE-2023-20592, AMD-SB-3005) lets a malicious hypervisor revert memory in an AMD SEV-ES/SEV-SNP guest to stale values using INVD, breaking memory integrity. Zen 3 affected, Zen 4 not; a microcode update is available.

AMD-SEV-SNP.evidence: AMD-SB-3005: potential impact 'Loss of Integrity'; a malicious hypervisor can cause the guest to use stale data, affecting SEV-ES/SEV-SNP guests on Zen 3.
